{{Top|leg}}
'''Dance pixies''' were small flying creatures native to [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion's]] plains that were used as ornamental pets. The petite, perfumed pixies were used as decorative entertainment by [[Baiuntu]], the chief of a [[Qulun]] trader-clan—a non-traditional faction of the [[Alwari]] tribes.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> while on a [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to prevent Ansion's [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|secession]] from the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] availed themselves of the "entertaining" nature of the dance pixies that "looped endlessly" about one of the chief trader [[Baiuntu]]'s portable, self-erecting trade rooms.<ref name="AS" />
